labels.name: complexity/low
labels.description: Mechanical or minimal design impact; high autonomy possible

labels.name: complexity/medium
labels.description: Bounded design decisions; moderate autonomy

labels.name: complexity/high
labels.description: Significant design impact

labels.name: risk/low
labels.description: Limited blast radius

labels.name: risk/medium
labels.description: Normal code changes

labels.name: risk/high
labels.description: Security, auth, data integrity, availability, or public API impact

labels.name: plan-approval-required
labels.description: Remove to resume after high-complexity classification (`plan-approval-resume` hands the issue to the PR gate)

labels.name: needs-info
labels.description: Missing reproduction steps or details

labels.name: backlog
labels.description: Valid but not urgent; do not plan or implement now

labels.name: dependency-required
labels.description: Waiting for a dependency; the watcher removes it when the dependency is finished

labels.name: dependency-satisfied
labels.description: Dependencies finished or cleared by a maintainer; issue triage lets the issue through

labels.name: related-repo
labels.description: Non-canonical issue; tracked in a related repository

labels.name: waiting-for-release
labels.description: Fix is merged; waiting for a release that includes it

labels.name: released
labels.description: A release includes this fix

labels.name: issue-worker-ready
labels.description: Issue worker finished

labels.name: issue-triage-handoff
labels.description: Issue triage finished; plan worker may run

labels.name: plan-worker-ready
labels.description: Plan worker finished

labels.name: plan-triage-handoff
labels.description: Plan triage finished; PR worker may run

labels.name: pr-worker-ready
labels.description: Coding agent finished

labels.name: pr-triage-handoff
labels.description: PR triage finished; merge rules may act

labels.name: duplicate
labels.description: Strong duplicate match

labels.name: already-fixed
labels.description: A later change addresses the report; closed

labels.name: invalid
labels.description: Cannot reproduce; nothing relevant changed after the issue was opened

secrets.name: COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Runs the Copilot engine for the gh-aw workflows (or enable organization Copilot billing)

secrets.name: SIGNAL_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Issues: Read and write. Applies and removes labels so the next gate starts

perRelatedRepository: For every related repository in .github/agentic-workflows/related-repos.md that names a secret: that secret, with Issues: Read and write on the other repository (used by issue-worker create-issue and the related-repo closer)
